purpose: Close historical OLD_P2 owned-output service omission; no algorithm tuning
schedule: original source lists from pinned cases.txt; q is followups after fixed unmodified A
order: cyclic rotation by session+round; parity reversal; exact reverse second sweep; no outcome-dependent choices
primary_metric: total_ns matches historical service window: workspace/executor/cache allocation, frozen A, publication, deferred reverse when required, q followups, owned outputs; excludes graph loading, oracle, reserve, validation, release and cleanup
additional_metrics: historical_prepare_ns: ready reverse construction outside total_ns
cleanup_window_ns: contiguous measured service window through validation/release/all teardown
lifecycle_ns: contiguous measured interval including ready reverse preparation, reserve, service, validation, release and all teardown
primary_pairing: geometric mean of two candidate/baseline ratios per session+round+graph+q; 21 primary blocks, 3 sessions; sweeps are not independent samples
gate: Guarded advantage requires median ratio <0.95, >=17/21 block wins, and all 3 session medians <0.95; also report reciprocal comparisons and all raw extrema
noise_control: same-variant sweep1/sweep0 ratios and session medians, no outlier deletion, no sequential-versus-concurrent claim
correctness: full array checks for every output, independent C++ deque oracle; separate 336 diagnostic arrays cross-checked with Python deque BFS; duplicate sources still return distinct owned outputs
memory: 32 MiB conservative payload cap; RSS separately reported, no total allocator/RSS equivalence claim
scope: Frozen legacy executor CPU experiment, not API adapter performance; API regression separately required; no GPU, paid resources, MAIN edits or vendor changes
